sequence: Opened the live DSH web UI and selected PTC mode for the interactive session (button label became "PTC mode").

With the PTC-mode agent active, called describe_image through the external MCP server; it returned: "The image is a solid, uniform red square. No text, shapes, gradients, or other visible features are apparent."
Created a NEW session in the same host; it opened in Standard mode, not PTC mode, so the selection is per-agent and did not become a deployment/global presentation toggle.
Called describe_image through MCP again from the native session; it returned: "The image is filled entirely with a solid, uniform red colour. No shapes, text, or other details are visible."
dshEvidence: apps/cli/tests/web-agent-presets.e2e.ts — "presents `ptc` as PTC mode without disturbing a native session beside it" proves two agents carry independent assemblies (PTC exposes run_code; native exposes bash) and the deployment default remains native.
conclusion: Changing the interactive agent to PTC did not break MCP direct calls; the PTC presentation was confined to its agent and a parallel native session kept the standard presentation.
